entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I... I need to return something. It's the Aero Road Helmet I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the account?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, order number 774-29B-91V. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this.

Okay, Sarah, I have your order right here. I see the Aero Road Helmet, delivered about 44 days ago. To make sure I understand, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a preference, I guess. The online photos made the color look like a vibrant red, but in person, it's more of a dull maroon. It just doesn't match my gear at all. I know the safety features are top-notch, but I can't get over the look.
I understand. The color of your gear is an important part of the experience. And is the item still in its original condition?

Oh, yes. The box is unopened. I looked at the helmet through the little plastic window on the side and just knew. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really was hoping I could get the money back. Things are a bit tight right now.

Of course, Sarah, I completely understand. Let me just check the policy for you... one moment. ... Okay, yes. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 44 and the box is unopened, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried. You've really taken a weight off my shoulders.

It's my pleasure to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see the refund processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful and understanding.
You are very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
No, that's everything. You have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
